title: The Heron and the Crab | Bedtime Story | ماهیخوار و خرچنگ
description:
The Heron and the Crab: an animated bedtime story for kids from Kalila & Dimna, the ancient book of Persian fables. A hungry old heron tells the fish one sweet lie... would you believe him?

قصه‌ی «ماهیخوار و خرچنگ» از کلیله و دمنه، به زبان انگلیسی با انیمیشن و موسیقی سنتور؛ برای بچه‌های ایرانی در سراسر دنیا و همه‌ی بچه‌هایی که قصه دوست دارند.

An old heron is too slow to catch fish anymore, so he makes a plan: he tells the fish that fishermen are coming with big nets, and offers to carry them, one by one, to a beautiful new lake. But there is no new lake... only a tiny muddy puddle behind the rocks! Then a little crab asks for a ride, and she looks with her own eyes. Kalila and Dimna, our two jackal storytellers, tell you how one small crab with two strong claws saves the whole lake. (Nobody gets hurt: the heron just flies away for good!)

Moral of the story: Don't believe sweet lies. Look and check first!
Persian word of the day: ماهی (maahi) = fish.

ABOUT KALILA & DIMNA
Kalila & Dimna is a book of animal fables that began as the ancient Indian Panchatantra. It was translated into Middle Persian, then into Arabic by Ibn al-Muqaffa, and later into Persian, becoming one of the most widely translated story collections in the world.

This is an original animated adaptation of a public-domain classic. The script, animation, character voices and santur music were all made for this channel, to share the wisdom of Persian storytelling with children everywhere.
